cairnryan_home_b_sandy.text: Glaur is thick mud. The path down to the harbour is mostly glaur in November.
In summer the basking sharks drift past, big as a boat and gentle as a cushion. Baskling comes with the warm months.

then.text: That is the lot for today, I am afraid. Mind how you go.

else.text: My sister in Larne sends me soda farls. I will not tell you how many I eat. Have one.
